**Cephalexin does not have a direct, dangerous interaction with alcohol, nor does alcohol stop the antibiotic from working** . However, ` [Highlight start] drinking alcohol while taking cephalexin is generally discouraged because it can worsen side effects and slow your recovery [Highlight end] ` . As noted by the [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1x72Q1h7QvK4YFpOWRqL6sJkiSG1dephpjBRVzdDpvMzMMRdC9hvqsHSwfQtRVPOUowm4GBzce6TZy4HdkhrPo35Qdy3KzjnsFFaZWfoOpl7XpYA2wTuehDGj5n6uiZI13CMLGU3ZbX1kgnEUi5-4zAP9z4sLlst-xJmsBa8FA) , drinking alcohol is permitted with cefalexin, though clinicians often recommend avoiding it until you feel better.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1x72Q1h7QvK4YFpOWRqL6sJkiSG1dephpjBRVzdDpvMzMMRdC9hvqsHSwfQtRVPOUowm4GBzce6TZy4HdkhrPo35Qdy3KzjnsFFaZWfoOpl7XpYA2wTuehDGj5n6uiZI13CMLGU3ZbX1kgnEUi5-4zAP9z4sLlst-xJmsBa8FA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXuLNq68LcThDoPd0TbW0lr0vOuF8Lsh_uuooNMpK3iG0oxgcRfgyf6KRP12Mx_R5nP06lEq_dxbDLJPPCYe3i114ZdO5O5s27Rimp5EaKKftnDi-bQQVbG3OBiTrbZA1iEYYsfkVm-cTmpZ7EIgcDgFlTduPvtsoEqRw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXsTHUxOdoH9wfC9mFrH1tEAqYQm03X-TXz1nJozzMzdf2Zkf0fX0M6kwyBXVDklPGyBFN_41eC5qDYgWiGONMXE0HhrH4q4hZxiQKvHdX-IwWydn-GIri44-H_XcfjX97plsPyw)

### Why Doctors Often Recommend Avoiding Alcohol

- **Worsened side effects:** Both cephalexin and alcohol can cause nausea, stomach upset, vomiting, diarrhea, and dizziness. Combining them can make these symptoms stronger.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXsTHUxOdoH9wfC9mFrH1tEAqYQm03X-TXz1nJozzMzdf2Zkf0fX0M6kwyBXVDklPGyBFN_41eC5qDYgWiGONMXE0HhrH4q4hZxiQKvHdX-IwWydn-GIri44-H_XcfjX97plsPyw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)
- **Slower recovery:** Alcohol can disrupt sleep, cause dehydration, and temporarily weaken your immune response while your body is fighting an infection. For urinary tract infections (UTIs), alcohol may also irritate the bladder.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXol2VD9WEJgGufRBs8_Askpy99GhGDEoXB7aMPwpYqgmlyoOpq-nRYp9YTbdpuEfwiVQY_ZNyvDjztxiPw8e4h6PapdqOSwozKCtI_1M7gNZzLsu2EkhFOUYP5yLSa8uc7ixEfz-P)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXsTHUxOdoH9wfC9mFrH1tEAqYQm03X-TXz1nJozzMzdf2Zkf0fX0M6kwyBXVDklPGyBFN_41eC5qDYgWiGONMXE0HhrH4q4hZxiQKvHdX-IwWydn-GIri44-H_XcfjX97plsPyw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)
- **Harder to track symptoms:** Hangovers or alcohol-related side effects can mimic or mask infection symptoms or medication reactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)
- **Missed doses:** Drinking can make it easier to forget a scheduled dose of your antibiotic.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g)

### Important Caveats

- **Disulfiram-like reactions:** Certain other cephalosporin antibiotics (such as cefotetan or cefoperazone) can cause a severe reaction—flushing, fast heartbeat, nausea, and low blood pressure—when mixed with alcohol. While cephalexin is not typically linked to this reaction, it belongs to the same antibiotic class.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXsTHUxOdoH9wfC9mFrH1tEAqYQm03X-TXz1nJozzMzdf2Zkf0fX0M6kwyBXVDklPGyBFN_41eC5qDYgWiGONMXE0HhrH4q4hZxiQKvHdX-IwWydn-GIri44-H_XcfjX97plsPyw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXKKk35M5nEHGvs-nVpBKuJxAfAh7V4dhcgEyoTg3eMid1fBJt-RNkvaRL1QGOvRnA-Os87x2U-kQ3Tdn9qkngPHTUhnYCzlGK7m3UUplwT-iesGuCVuGON_um-F6z_WgzTRUlld9RjA)
- **Kidney function and other medications:** Your kidneys clear cephalexin from your body, and your overall health or other prescriptions may change how you tolerate alcohol. A breakdown of alcohol and antibiotic interactions is available in Fact versus Fiction: a Review of the Evidence behind Alcohol and Antibiotic Interactions , and further context on drinking patterns is covered by [Rehab 4 Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXsTHUxOdoH9wfC9mFrH1tEAqYQm03X-TXz1nJozzMzdf2Zkf0fX0M6kwyBXVDklPGyBFN_41eC5qDYgWiGONMXE0HhrH4q4hZxiQKvHdX-IwWydn-GIri44-H_XcfjX97plsPyw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrw2CZARbSbkDV8L4zunjDF6eYbAOBI70zIQ0bGV2ueuaYsZfVIgNQNWcJysXSxBjA1b12xH0flztg6vDg4gKKsjSNd0a_AVKJTuHUcSF759-pAvKq-LnjbcI9_klfPdoKqE2DUoXpg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g)

A breakdown of alcohol and antibiotic interactions is available in Fact versus Fiction: a Review of the Evidence behind Alcohol and Antibiotic Interactions , and further context on drinking patterns is covered by [Rehab 4 Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXsTHUxOdoH9wfC9mFrH1tEAqYQm03X-TXz1nJozzMzdf2Zkf0fX0M6kwyBXVDklPGyBFN_41eC5qDYgWiGONMXE0HhrH4q4hZxiQKvHdX-IwWydn-GIri44-H_XcfjX97plsPyw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF12R5yOXKRpRVjW90FDSHMk3gpJL-M-Z69aaRj3hsDJETWPgv7eARBSt_urRt7NxlHp-zQ4hUBXG2Zh1Hm4HUB8jngy_MCsRB5CDDDJOJ4SBxVN01sHzzM34je5FQyNvMi2jBSfeIKNk2LZHMR3QMI9d3KJarYZuyiYWUp_zSXQGlfJyEgnOsti2B8eIL8c0W8g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXrw2CZARbSbkDV8L4zunjDF6eYbAOBI70zIQ0bGV2ueuaYsZfVIgNQNWcJysXSxBjA1b12xH0flztg6vDg4gKKsjSNd0a_AVKJTuHUcSF759-pAvKq-LnjbcI9_klfPdoKqE2DUoXpg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXX5IKpFrUmBKVzldnEHQGMBYigvjJUplkE9sAMBj-Nj2CqUVJ499IBCJuwGoJUxr95Blb4MRf9BvEiXZh13Huw5ZeMkx0ji9Dnn9Nbm_o2PkMRHdsvst_6J6Xx3zrNS3ubEO0Mw1Sf6bq6DOsZB5L1ij_fCIt-YHZp1g)
